label: jex-dam4s-run4
_why: RUN 4 OF THE jex-dam4s BATCH (user, 2026-10-09 late evening: "Add run four to this all before you finalize the report"). The same book, the same telemetry and harvest as 20261009_193145_jex-dam4s-n3 (runs 1-3); launched automatically when that session wrote SCHEDULE DONE; read pooled with it as n=4.

_arms.dam4s: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s.json} (+ its tree twin, the jex book's).

_comparison: Against the jex book, n=16 (20261005_154629 runs 1-8 + 20261006_193418, same book with per-project dams and is_shown_when_inactive research entries): the wall clock in the three ruled clusters (wall_clusters.mjs) and the tick overhead by period (tick_overhead.mjs) beside vanilla n=16; the criteria register (criteria.mjs); dams built, by whom, and the slot check (dam_yearly.mjs, dam_slots.mjs); research timing and delivery (tech_timing.mjs, je_tally.mjs); input-price red flags.

_predictions.wall clock: F221 measured V1+V2 at -3.5 s per in-game year in 1836-45 (70% of the gap to vanilla); over the century the main median falls from the jex book's ~184 min towards vanilla's ~165 (expect ~170-178): the research saving stays constant, the dam saving grows once dams are built (4 building types instead of 144)
_predictions.dams: more dam levels than the jex book (25-150 levels a run of 312) in electricity terms, because a level now costs half as many points per unit of electricity; the first Mountain Power Stations from ~1890 (electrical_generation), the Great River Dams only after arc_welding (~1920s)
_predictions.slot check: zero breaches: built + queued never above a region's slots, whoever builds; outside-family builders (investment rights) ~30-45% of queued levels, as in the jex runs
_predictions.economy: world GDP and the register within the jex book's seed spread; electricity cheaper where many dams stand

_stop_rule: none: a fixed n=3, every run plays to 1936. Only a hard harness failure (crash loop, mod not loaded) stops it.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Do NOT edit tools/testbed/save_state_summary.mjs, tools/emit_dams.mjs, tools/lib_dams.mjs, tools/emit_research_events.mjs or the book while the batch runs.
run_schedule.ps1 adds the red-flag feed (market_goods_wide each 1 July) and the machine-load monitor.
